cards.stem: What is the 2026 standard deduction for married couples filing jointly?
cards.quote: For tax year 2026, the standard deduction increases to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly.
cards.hint: Look for the married filing jointly amount in 2026.

cards.stem: What top marginal rate applies in 2026 for single taxpayers above the highest threshold?
cards.quote: For tax year 2026, the top tax rate remains 37% for individual single taxpayers with incomes greater than $640,600
cards.hint: Check the highest bracket rate listed for 2026.

cards.stem: What is the basic estate exclusion amount for decedents who die in 2026?
cards.quote: Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000,
cards.hint: Find the basic exclusion for estates in 2026.

cards.stem: What is the 2026 maximum earned income credit for taxpayers with three or more qualifying children?
cards.quote: The tax year 2026 maximum Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) amount is $8,231 for qualifying taxpayers who have three or more qualifying children,
cards.hint: Locate the maximum credit for three or more qualifying children.
